title: Nick Brown named director of graduate recruitment
summary_en: Nick Brown has been named K-State’s director of graduate recruitment, bringing more than 15 years of enrollment and admissions experience to the role.

title: Exceptional students earn early admission to K-State veterinary college
summary_en: Fourteen future veterinarians are getting a head start on their professional training at K-State thanks to the College of Veterinary Medicine's Early Admission Program.
